metric_defs.R0: last RESOLVED_REDUCE day before any ADD (repeated REDUCE moves R0, contract rule)
metric_defs.A0: first RESOLVED_ADD day after R0 in same lifecycle
metric_defs.det_X: X@R0 - mean(X over R0-5..R0-1 valid rows) — deterioration at reduce
metric_defs.rep_X: X@A0 - X@R0 — repair between reduce and re-add (RECOVERED_ADD only; NaN otherwise)
metric_defs.bh_R0_Hh: cum_ret_from_t0_log at last day with (day - R0) >= h, minus value at R0 — buy&hold path from R0 (PIT prefix stat); NaN if no such day
metric_defs.censored_cyc: lifecycle censored (terminal_reason=MAX_HORIZON) with cycle unresolved at data end
